newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm as cash markets stay strong.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm as cash markets stay strong.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on strong cash markets, traders said.
"The bottom line is the market continues to liquidate into strong commercial buying," a trader said. "The futures broke down Wednesday but the cash market didn't budge."
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 1,100 contracts, about the same as the 1,085 traded Wednesday.
Rice closed unchanged to 11 cents per cwt higher, with March up 2-1/2 at $11.87-1/2.
